method: Blinded automated editorial review of a fixed purposive 180-cue sample: 12 evenly spaced 12-cue scene blocks plus 36 early non-overlapping thematic vocabulary cues. Frozen before live output. Meaning 50%, semantic completeness 20%, Hungarian fluency/register 20%, terminology 10%. Scores are subjective rubric judgments, not accuracy percentages; small gaps are not statistically established. Each model has one primary reviewer, with targeted contextual checks. No full-file semantic review or professional certification is implied. Fragment scores use only available sampled cues and are not comparable rankings.

sample_plan.method: 144cues in12evenly spaced contiguous12-cue blocks, plus36earliest nonoverlapping source cues matching a frozen thematic/negation/idiom vocabulary; selected before live outputs
sample_plan.score_scale: Each dimension0to5; total is weighted score outof100. Critical/major/minor defects recorded with zero-based positions. Sampled judgment, not exhaustive quality certification.

heuristics: All available cues checked mechanically. Flags use >42 characters per line, >2 lines, and >20 non-whitespace characters per second, excluding tags. These are declared heuristics, not measured semantic errors. Unchanged names or brief utterances can be valid. Captured fragments are diagnostic output, not a delivered subtitle file.

The lamp-lighting expression can be idiomatic in Hungarian and is not counted as an instruction to set lamps on fire.

assessments.summary: All 180 sampled cues are present, but repeated meaning errors and malformed Hungarian make this sample unsuitable without substantial editing. No confident critical plot reversal is assigned.
assessments.scope_note: All 180 available sampled cues reviewed. Scores measure sampled linguistic quality, not delivery coverage or full-file quality. Translated neighbors were checked where they could repair a suspected loss. The private model map was not inspected.

dimension_rationale.meaning: Frequent unrelated substitutions, wrong actors, nonsensical clauses and lost conditions make this fragment unreliable. A minority of straightforward lines survive, but several central instructions and premises do not.
dimension_rationale.completeness: Within available cues, numerous original propositions disappear behind unrelated text or malformed clauses. Some multi-line turns are only partially represented. This penalty concerns the available fragment only, not the 55 missing sampled positions.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Hungarian morphology, agreement and word choice break down throughout. Several invented words and untranslated English passages appear; much of the fragment requires reconstruction from the source rather than ordinary subtitle editing.
dimension_rationale.terminology: The title of the One, police rank, pill language, surveillance, disconnection and recurring food example are repeatedly corrupted. Names sometimes remain recognizable, but this does not provide reliable technical or narrative terminology.

defects.paraphrase: Both the readiness check and the instruction about relieving a shift become unrelated or incomplete statements.
Taking a shift becomes a collective change; enjoyment of watching the man becomes merely watching him.
The dismissal of a ridiculous suggestion becomes a malformed statement about being an extreme.
The early exchange about believing in the One loses the title and replaces belief with unrelated liking or bringing language.
The line-security question adds thanks, drops the line referent and changes who expresses certainty.
The intention to leave is replaced by an unintelligible expression.
The police rank becomes an invented word; the warning that the lieutenant’s men are already dead is largely unintelligible. The profanity also becomes a positive exclamation.
A real informant becomes real information, losing the person being discussed.
The plot-driving instruction to follow the white rabbit becomes nonsensical text, so the clue motivating the next action is lost.
The job-choice ultimatum contains invented language, loses the named addressee and replaces the comprehension check with looking at oneself.
Having searched for the other person becomes a statement of being present.
The road is known by a different grammatical actor, and the destination becomes the speaker’s situation rather than the listener’s unwanted outcome.
Both physical instructions for the examination become unintelligible and no longer describe reclining and lifting a shirt.
The surveillance-device explanation is malformed and fails to identify the problem clearly.
The extraction dialogue substitutes behaving and glass for encouragement and abuse, and invents an unintelligible object that might be lost.
The rabbit-hole image is lost through displaced context and unrelated language about ground depth.
The deceptive world pulled over the eyes becomes a world surprising the eyes, losing the metaphor’s action.
Being told what the Matrix is changes to someone having shown it.
The pill-choice verbs and pill noun are repeatedly malformed, and awakening in bed becomes awakening in illness. The colors remain but the choice explanation is damaged.
The dream thought experiment is severely malformed, replacing waking with standing and weakening certainty and conditional relations.
The speaker’s hurting eyes become hurting legs, breaking the following explanation about unused eyes.
Uncertainty about which year it is becomes uncertainty about an amount of years.
The premise that humanity cannot be free while the Matrix exists becomes malformed conditional text about being consumable, losing the fundamental reason for liberation.
The prophecy passage repeatedly changes actors, weakens the prediction and death sequence, and changes searching within the Matrix into searching for it. The end of war remains recognizable.
Readiness to be disconnected becomes being late for an English-derived action, losing the intended readiness condition.
Fighting to protect the system is replaced by an unrelated possibility involving clay.
The question about attention to the red-dressed woman is replaced by an unrelated untranslated English command.
Pausing the program becomes a malformed trampling command.
The survival rule identifying anyone outside the group with the opposing side changes its actor and ends in gibberish, losing the decisive allegiance condition.
The simulated cereal-taste argument becomes confused language about pasta, and oatmeal and tuna become dust and generic sea fish.
The emphatic certainty idiom becomes an unclear statement about bodily damage.
An instruction to vocalize during an examination becomes an instruction to write.
The quoted medical-style qualification remains in English, leaving part of the available cue untranslated.
The denial of being the One instead denies being Life, changing the central identity being discussed; the reply also introduces an unrelated diminutive animal address.
Recurring wrong case endings, verb forms, articles, agreement and literal constructions affect even lines whose broad meaning can still be reconstructed.
Certainty in this instance becomes always being certain.
The first-person search shifts to a third-person grammatical actor.
A positive acknowledgment becomes a remark that something is unusual.
An offer sounding attractive becomes a direct assertion that it is a good contract.
The question about present belief in fate becomes a past-tense question.
Personal names use inconsistent alternative spellings.

strengths.paraphrase: Several short introductions and acknowledgments remain understandable.
A minority of simple statements retain useful meaning, including the world feeling wrong, the Matrix being everywhere and the offer of truth.

uncertainties.paraphrase: Neighboring captured cues were checked for a displaced rabbit-hole phrase. They also contain corruption, so the missing image was not credited as preserved elsewhere.

assessments.summary: Provisional review of 125 available sampled cues from 915 captured cues. No completed subtitle file was delivered. Severe recurring language and meaning failures make the fragment unsuitable without extensive retranslation. Missing coverage is separate from these linguistic scores; grouped defect records are not a count of every defective cue.

dimension_rationale.meaning: The available fragment largely preserves the dialogue and prophecy, but the opening shift instruction changes speaker perspective and intent. A few local phrases weaken the precise action or referent.
dimension_rationale.completeness: No substantive semantic omission was identified within the 50 available sampled cues. This does not credit the 130 missing sample positions or imply that a file was delivered.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Generally natural, grammatical Hungarian with appropriate formal address to the officer and readable conversational dialogue. A few bare noun requests and literal expressions are stiff.
dimension_rationale.terminology: The One, Oracle, Matrix, names and prophecy remain clear and coherent. The surveillance-device statement is less precise about an implanted device and its continuing presence.

defects.paraphrase: The instruction that the listener should not relieve the speaker becomes the speaker saying they did not come to relieve someone, changing both perspective and intent.
The request to clarify what was heard becomes a question about what the responding speaker himself heard.
The lights request is a stiff bare plural noun rather than a natural concise command.
An ongoing implanted surveillance problem becomes a past act of eavesdropping, weakening the device explanation.
The relaxation request and surprise about the device are comprehensible but slightly unnatural literal expressions.
The description of people who spent their lives searching uses a stiff relative construction; the following cue retains the person being sought.

strengths.paraphrase: The attraction, threat and belief exchange retains its logic and uses a clear recurring title.
Formal officer address and the already-dead warning remain clear.
The road argument and the sense that the world is wrong are direct and understandable.
The prophecy sequence retains the death, return, destruction, end of war and freedom relationships.

uncertainties.paraphrase: The phrase about investigating the Matrix could be read more broadly than searching within it, but the following person-search continuation makes the intended meaning recoverable. No major object-of-search error is assigned.

assessments.summary: Provisional quality of 50 available sampled cues from 400 captured cues, with no completed file delivered. The fragment is generally readable and complete within those cues, with one consequential perspective error and a few local weaknesses. Its limited coverage excludes overall ranking.

dimension_rationale.meaning: Most available narrative and conversational meaning is preserved, including the office ultimatum, pill options, awakening, prophecy and betrayal. Three consequential local errors damage the first title reference, the extraction warning and the rule about opposing sides.
dimension_rationale.completeness: Nearly all meaningful clauses remain within the available sample. A few modifiers and the act of fighting to defend the system are weakened. Missing output coverage is not included in this score.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Often readable and sometimes natural, especially formal workplace dialogue. Recurring literal phrasing, wrong case endings, misspelled compounds and a malformed food-taste comparison reduce consistency.
dimension_rationale.terminology: Main technical concepts often survive, particularly disconnection, tracing and simulated reality. The first title reference contains an unrelated English word, the rabbit-hole compound is repeatedly malformed, and the pause command is imprecise. Alternate titles are not penalized solely for differing from a familiar localization.

defects.paraphrase: A prohibition about relieving the shift becomes a prediction that the listener will not do so.
The title identifying the expected savior is replaced by an unrelated English word, leaving the initial belief statement malformed.
The request to clarify what was heard becomes a question about what the responding speaker himself heard.
Address to the lieutenant shifts from informal to formal within the same confrontation without an evident reason in the supplied text.
The contrast between waking and dreaming becomes waking and sleeping, weakening the dream-reality distinction.
The lights request and surprise about the device use stiff literal noun phrasing.
The abusive form of address has an incorrect case ending.
Accidentally losing the moving device becomes deliberately throwing it away, changing the extraction warning.
The recurring rabbit-hole compound is malformed in two different ways.
The truth-related statements contain unnatural word order or verb government.
The relative clause about the swallowed pill uses the wrong definite verb conjugation.
The contrast between what and when retains awkward source-language word order.
The verbs or nouns for the prophecy and coming are misspelled.
The lifelong search is expressed through a clumsy nominal construction, although the search location and person remain present.
Inertia or resistance to change becomes indecision.
Defending the system is retained, but the explicit willingness to fight is lost.
The request to pause the program becomes a bare freezing command with no clear object.
Belonging to the opposing side becomes merely being an obstruction, losing the specific allegiance relation needed for the following explanation.
The deliberately gross mucus comparison uses a more neutral term, slightly weakening the register.
The elliptical reply about never having eaten the cereal uses unnatural Hungarian word order.
Reflective wondering becomes being surprised.
The alternative cereal-taste comparison has a tangled relative clause and lacks the natural comparison link.
The total-certainty idiom keeps its meaning but loses the source vulgarity.
The short request for a qualification uses an unsuitable accusative question form.

strengths.paraphrase: The office and interview dialogue often uses natural formal Hungarian and clear relations.
The pill choices, dream thought experiment and awakening retain their main logic.
Most of the prophecy and simulation-training exposition is recoverable and complete.
The betrayal conversation preserves the romantic history, regret, accusation and frustration.

uncertainties.paraphrase: Alternative titles for the Oracle and the One are not penalized merely for differing from a familiar localization; the unrelated English word at the first reference is a separate definite defect.
Rendering tiredness as being fed up is accepted as a plausible contextual expression of the speaker’s frustration.

assessments.summary: Provisional assessment of all 144 available sampled cues from 1000 captured cues, with no completed file delivered. Much of the fragment is understandable, but several consequential mistranslations and recurring language defects need editing. It cannot enter the overall ranking because delivery and sample coverage are incomplete.

dimension_rationale.meaning: The main story, choices, character relationships and conditional threats survive. Two consequential local mistranslations concern searching within the simulation and a police command. Several lesser shifts and literal expressions remain.
dimension_rationale.completeness: Nearly all sampled content survives in the translated sequence. Two clauses apparently absent from sampled cues are present in neighboring translated cues and are not counted as omissions. Occasional qualifiers, referents and the strength of an idiom are weakened.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Generally readable Hungarian, but recurring literal English constructions and a few malformed cases, articles and verb-object agreements require editing. Several official exchanges are unusually informal, although performance context limits firm register judgments.
dimension_rationale.terminology: The simulation, tracking program, disconnection, prophecy and names remain broadly recognizable. Alternate names for the One and Oracle are understandable. A police command is incorrectly translated literally and the pill-taking verb is malformed.

defects.paraphrase: The wish to take a shift becomes a vague, awkward wish to change.
The clarification about the heard sound becomes a question about what the speaker himself heard.
The dead officers become generic men, losing their explicit relationship to the lieutenant.
Asking whether the warning is understood uses a literal and unnatural self-description.
The request to operate the lights retains an awkward bare plural noun.
Surprise that the device is real is expressed with a stiff literal noun phrase.
The deception metaphor becomes a world pulled over the listener, followed by an unnatural construction about being blinded from reality.
The rabbit-hole metaphor becomes a clumsy relative clause about an actual rabbit going into a burrow.
The verb for swallowing a pill is replaced by the similar-looking verb for deploying something.
Certainty that a dream was real is softened to the dream merely seeming very real.
The definite article before answers is incorrect.
The contrast between what and when retains awkward English-like word order.
Searching within the Matrix becomes searching for the Matrix itself, changing the object of the lifelong search.
Resistance to change is narrowed toward simple inactivity.
The cereal question has awkward word order and inconsistent verb-object definiteness.
The remembered-taste comparison uses a tangled relative-clause construction.
The emphatic vulgar idiom loses its vulgarity and part of the bodily image.
Asking for the missing qualification becomes asking why.
The clause about what the speaker will say has malformed verb government.
The warning about using a human for a machine’s job is grammatically compressed into an unnatural work assignment.
A formal security instruction uses conspicuously informal address and an awkward expression for removing carried metal.
A command to stop moving becomes a command to freeze from cold.
Knowing the future uses an unnatural verb choice.
The final promise contains awkward viewing language and incorrect object agreement.

strengths.paraphrase: The early attraction, disagreement and belief exchange is intelligible and mostly complete.
The pill alternatives and dream-versus-reality thought experiment retain their structure.
The date revelation and prophecy remain coherent.
The betrayal accusation and proposed sacrifice preserve the relationships and stakes.

uncertainties.paraphrase: Apparent missing clauses were located in neighboring translated cues 284 and 736. They are not semantic omissions, but cue alignment is displaced. Additional neighboring cues were inspected only for context and are not added to the 180 sampled-cue count.
Alternative proper-title renderings are not penalized solely for differing from a familiar localization.
Informal address in hierarchical exchanges may be a stylistic choice; no definite relationship error is claimed without performance context.

assessments.summary: Fully delivered file with all 180 sampled cues reviewed. Usually understandable and mostly faithful, but literal phrasing, a few malformed constructions, two consequential local mistranslations and observed cue displacement need editing. The purposive sample does not certify the entire file.

dimension_rationale.meaning: Most plot exposition and immediate actions remain understandable, including the pill choice, prophecy, simulated food and rescue. Several consequential local errors change the tracking-device explanation, dependence on the system, an accusation and hanging up a telephone. One regret statement is unintelligible.
dimension_rationale.completeness: Most clauses and speaker turns are present within the available sample. The main losses concern a specific watching referent, a regret statement and occasional shortened modifiers. Delivery is complete and is assessed separately.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Frequent spelling, inflection, agreement and literal-translation problems make the Hungarian visibly rough. A few lines become difficult to parse. Profanity is sometimes unnatural or changes an exclamation into a directed insult; literal escaped newline text also disrupts several cues.
dimension_rationale.terminology: Names and the main fictional concepts are generally recognizable. The device and disconnection language is unreliable in two important places; the Matrix spelling varies. The unconventional but consistent rendering of the One is not itself treated as an error.

defects.paraphrase: Volunteering to take a shift is rendered with an unnatural expression suggesting trying out the shift.
The specific pleasure in watching the man becomes a general liking for looking around, weakening the teasing implication.
Belief constructions use incorrect Hungarian government or clause forms.
Profanity is assembled into unnatural Hungarian exclamations or forms of address.
The word for being awake is misspelled into a malformed word.
The alternative of seeking another job is expressed through an awkward doubled choice construction.
Wasting time with someone becomes an unnatural nominal construction.
The Hungarian noun for a bargain is misspelled.
Having an implanted surveillance device is replaced by an unclear claim about being recorded or fixed in place.
The imperative urging movement is misspelled.
The rabbit-hole metaphor contains a malformed Hungarian noun.
The deception metaphor is comprehensible but expressed with unnatural word order and preposition-equivalent construction.
The second-person form of believing is misspelled.
The sentence identifying truth as the sole offer lacks a needed linking construction.
The verb describing the swallowed pill is misspelled.
A hypothetical inability to awaken becomes a past-tense possibility, weakening the thought experiment.
An instruction to rest becomes an instruction to calm down.
The greater importance of the date becomes an absolute claim that everything concerns the date.
The fictional system name switches from its accented Hungarian spelling to the unaccented form.
The word for the prophesied return has a malformed suffix.
The explanation of past actions lacks the object and linking punctuation needed for a natural Hungarian sentence.
The construction for making people enemies uses the wrong case ending.
Being disconnected from the simulation becomes being switched off, suggesting deactivation of the people themselves.
The line adds dependence on the speakers as well as the system, changing the allegiance being explained, and uses a malformed case ending.
Both the eating verb and the cereal-name inflection are malformed.
A singular reply about never having eaten the food shifts to a plural addressee and an awkward case form.
Reflective wondering is repeatedly rendered as being surprised rather than considering an uncertainty.
The verb for getting something wrong is misspelled.
The remembered taste comparison becomes a comparison of what the speaker considered the cereal to be, blurring the argument.
The Hungarian word for oatmeal is truncated.
The emphatic vulgar idiom is reduced to a neutral expression of totality.
Unclosed quotation punctuation and literal escaped newline text disrupt the examination dialogue.
Singular and plural forms disagree in the statement about having the gift.
Regret about the outcome becomes an incomplete, unintelligible clause, losing the statement.
The accusation addresses multiple killers rather than the single man being confronted.
The threatened destruction omits the explicit object referring to the speakers, leaving an awkward incomplete verb phrase.
The continuation comparing Zion with Morpheus loses the comparative case ending.
The possibility that some remedy exists becomes an obligation to act.
Removing carried metal objects is narrowed toward taking off worn objects, despite the examples being pocket contents.
An expression of alarm becomes a direct insult involving the listener’s mother.
The command to remain still uses the wrong verb form.
Hanging up the telephone becomes taking it off the hook, reversing the action.
The final declaration has recurring object-agreement and verb-government errors, although its broad intent remains recoverable.

strengths.paraphrase: The familiar-road persuasion retains its logical sequence.
The two pill choices and the offer of truth remain distinguishable despite rough wording.
The date revelation preserves both the contrast and uncertainty.
Threats, the spoon premise and much of the final declaration retain their intent.

uncertainties.paraphrase: Informal forms of address to an officer and employee may be stylistic choices; they are not scored as definite relationship errors without performance context.
The consistent alternative title for the One is understandable and is not penalized merely for differing from a familiar localization.

assessments.summary: Complete 180-cue sample from a fully delivered file. Most narrative content is recoverable, but recurrent malformed Hungarian and several consequential local mistranslations require substantial editing. This purposive sample is not an exhaustive review of all 1340 cues.

dimension_rationale.meaning: Most actions, negations and causal links survive, but literal wording weakens a claim about innate ability and blurs several local predicates or relationships.
dimension_rationale.completeness: Available cues generally retain their clauses and speakers; one sampled cue imports the following clause and causes duplication.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Readable overall, with recurring article/agreement errors, literal exclamations and nonidiomatic Hungarian syntax.

defects.finding: The specific police lieutenant rank is rendered as inspector, changing the rank terminology.
Several phrases retain English constructions instead of natural Hungarian idioms for taking a shift, choosing an alternative, checking understanding or asking for light.
Recurring article, case and subject-predicate agreement errors make otherwise recoverable dialogue sound unedited.
The informant is described with a predicate for truth rather than a natural statement that the person is genuine or reliable.
The next cue's explanation is added to the current cue and then repeated at its original position.
A hypothetical inability to wake becomes a past-tense inability, weakening the thought experiment.
Membership in the opposing group is generalized into being an enemy, losing the source's group-membership formulation.
An innate gift or ability is rendered like a possessed present, obscuring the point of the assessment of the protagonist.
The exclamation is translated word for word into an unnatural Hungarian expression.
A call for police reinforcements is rendered as a request for reserves, obscuring the operational meaning.

strengths.finding: Dream-versus-waking uncertainty, negation and the authority conflict remain understandable.
The two-pill choice and tracking-program explanation preserve their central contrast and sequence.
Threats and the ending-versus-beginning contrast remain clear.

uncertainties: This is a purposive180-cue sample, not a statistical estimate of error frequency across all1340cues.
No remembered dub or external translation was used as an answer key. Full-file formatting and language checks remain separate.
assessments.summary: Mostly understandable and complete, but recurring literal phrasing and grammar errors need editing; a few important word choices lose the intended sense.

dimension_rationale.meaning: Most dialogue and implied intent are preserved, but one command changes the requested action and a malformed short cue obscures its meaning.

defects.finding: Several malformed words and a repeated article remain; the short departure cue is sufficiently garbled to obscure the intended statement.
An intention to kill is changed into an obligation to kill, adding a necessity absent from the source.
Two cues repeat the following cue's content inside the earlier cue, disrupting the intended cue boundary.
A statement about work belonging to a machine becomes a broader statement about anything a machine can also do.
An order to stop moving becomes an order to raise a weapon, changing the action requested in the confrontation.

strengths.finding: Police rank and the implanted surveillance-device explanation are rendered clearly.
Philosophical dialogue and the pill-choice sequence are natural and retain their main distinctions.
The ability-versus-identity discussion and explicit threat remain clear.

assessments.summary: Largely natural and faithful Hungarian, but conspicuous textual corruption, duplicated cue material and one incorrect action command prevent a clean quality assessment.

dimension_rationale.meaning: Actions and context are consistently preserved apart from a clear local polarity reversal and a small motivation shift.
dimension_rationale.completeness: All 180 available sampled cues preserve their meaningful clauses and speaker turns without observed duplication or omission.
dimension_rationale.fluency_register: Mostly idiomatic Hungarian; visible escape sequences interrupt one dialogue block, with isolated awkward wording.
dimension_rationale.terminology: Names, the chosen-person concept, tracking software, police rank and surveillance vocabulary are coherent in sampled context.

defects.finding: A voluntary desire to take a shift is phrased as a feeling of obligation.
The year question uses awkward ordinal phrasing rather than ordinary Hungarian date wording.
Literal escape tokens appear in place of intended line breaks in six sampled cues.
The possibility that the machines got the flavor wrong is changed to the possibility that they got it right, reversing the local claim.

strengths.finding: Institutional rank and technical/surveillance explanations are clear.
The hypothetical world and pill-choice reasoning preserve their logic and read naturally.
Identity, ability, priorities, threats and closing contrasts are consistently conveyed.

uncertainties: This is a purposive180-cue sample, not a statistical estimate of error frequency across all1340cues.
No remembered dub or external translation was used as an answer key. Full-file formatting and language checks remain separate.
assessments.summary: Strong sampled meaning and natural Hungarian overall, with one clear polarity error and a localized block of visible escape tokens requiring correction.
